# vue-rtl-kit

> MIT-licensed Vue 3.3+ and Nuxt 3/4 toolkit for reactive RTL/LTR direction, scoped layouts, logical styles, locale-aware formatting, and simplified plain-text bidirectional isolation.

Current documented release: v0.1.1. Until npm publication, install with `npm install github:MarwanMaher0/vue-rtl-kit#v0.1.1`; its prepare script builds the package. Do not present `npm install vue-rtl-kit` as the currently published installation path.

BidiText is not a rich-text engine or a complete Unicode bidi algorithm implementation. Explicit initial `dir`, `setDirection()`, and `toggleDirection()` pin root direction against later locale changes. The toolkit does not translate messages or automatically convert an entire interface to RTL.

## Start here

- [English documentation](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/): Project overview and shared FAQ.
- [Getting started](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/getting-started): Tagged release installation and Vue/Nuxt setup.
- [API reference](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/api): Exported functions, components, directives, and TypeScript types.
- [Full text reference](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/llms-full.txt): Substantive setup, behavioral contracts, limitations, examples, and bilingual source links.

## Direction and integration

- [Direction store](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/direction-store): Reactive state, pinning, document sync, and standalone state.
- [createRtl](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/create-rtl): Vue plugin configuration and cleanup.
- [useDirection](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/use-direction): Nearest scope, root, or detached fallback.
- [useRtl](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/use-rtl): Root store access; requires the installed plugin.
- [RtlProvider](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/rtl-provider): Local direction and locale scopes.
- [v-rtl](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/v-rtl): Element direction, optional isolation, SSR, and cleanup.
- [Nuxt module](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/nuxt-module): Nuxt 3/4 setup and registration caveats.

## Text, layout, and formatting

- [BidiText](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/bidi-text): Plain-text run isolation and rich-markup limits.
- [useLogicalStyles](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/use-logical-styles): JavaScript style conversion and mirrored offsets.
- [CSS utilities](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/css-utilities): Optional logical spacing, positioning, borders, text isolation, and icon helpers.
- [useFormat](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/use-format): Scope-aware Intl numbers, currencies, dates, and numbering systems.
